source: User-supplied TMIS Logical Data Model, schema v2 (2026-11-11)
notes: TMIS Logical Data Model: schema v2, transcribed from the supplied reference diagram.
31 entities and 213 fields; no entities merged or removed.
The reference draws 60 relationships and omits 18 agency_id tenant links for readability. All 78 foreign-key relationships remain available here.
UUID, bool and int are logical type notation; this update does not migrate a database.
UK marks a unique field. Nullable field names are italic; nullability also appears in field details.
activity.calendar_entry_id and certificate_rule.activity_id are unique foreign keys (at most one child per parent).
Relationship labels identify the foreign-key field in the child table. Optional parents correspond to nullable foreign keys.
Child minimum counts remain zero where the reference does not establish mandatory child existence.
client_id is a unique UUID in attendance, feedback and reentry_plan; no client entity or foreign-key relationship is shown.
Composite uniqueness: session(activity_id, session_date, period); activity_partner(activity_id, partner_agency_id).
session.period: AM | PM. program_flow requires end_time > start_time.
The original draw.io file remains an archived v1 reference. The downloadable Mermaid source describes v2.
